registration.statement: Molecular electron affinity retains the complete neutral carrier, held electron-gain action and resulting anion state. Conventional sign is replaced by a held state-order orientation: a bound anion lies below the neutral-plus-electron state, while an unbound anion lies above it. In either orientation the magnitude is the exact positive higher-state Take lower-state; coincident states carry structural EmptyOne. The law and all 96 identities seal before the complete NIST experimental vector opens.
registration.title: Exact molecular electron-affinity state-order and magnitude law
